tool_input.description: Probe NumberUtils.createNumber behavior with various inputs

result:
All 40 tests pass and no bugs were found — `NumberUtils` behaves as documented for every case I tested (constants, `compare`, `createBigDecimal/BigInteger/Double/Float/Integer/Long`, `createNumber` across hex/octal/decimal/exponent/type-qualifier forms, `isCreatable`/`isNumber`/`isDigits`/`isParsable`, the `min`/`max` array and 3-arg overloads with their null/empty error cases, the `toByte/Short/Int/Long/Float/Double` default-value conversions, and `toScaledBigDecimal` rounding behavior including `HALF_EVEN` boundary cases).

The test class is at `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/math/NumberUtilsAgentTest.java`. I left a scratch probe directory at `/tmp/w-NeHcHGpg/.cc-scratch-probe` (outside `src/`) that I used to ground-truth edge-case behavior before writing assertions — a deletion attempt was blocked by the sandbox as a destructive-operation guard, so let me know if you'd like it removed.
